团部大院内，灯火通明，人来来往往，行色匆匆，氛围无比紧张。碰见熟人，还没开口，嘴里先是吐出一缕白雾。
指挥部内，高团长正在跟政委和参谋讨论新兵训练及装备转运的问题。
“报告！团长，政委，三营九连战士刘济民奉命归队！”
指挥部内众人都被刘济民的声音给吸引了，高团长合上文件走到刘济民面前打量片刻，笑眯眯地对其他人说道：“看，我们的刺头回来了。这家伙可不得了，在燕影厂拍电影，打了好几个人。”
“团长，您不能一见面就揭我的短啊！”刘济民笑道。
政委赵青寿走了过来，高兴地说道：“我们的鲁迅回来了？”
“政委好！”
“好好好，不用那么大声，一路辛苦了。”
高团长冲门外喊道：“去端碗面进来，别把我们的鲁迅饿成周树人了。”
“哈哈哈，团长，您还挺幽默！”
“你先吃，吃完我再跟你聊。”
团部食堂一直热着灶，等面条端上来后，刘济民胃口大开，拿起筷子迅速搅拌了三圈，三口化作两口，没一会儿就消灭了一碗面条。
“呦，胃口挺好，吃饱没，没吃饱再来一碗。”
“吃饱了，团长。”
高团长从口袋里拿出一根烟塞进嘴里，美美吸了一口后说道：“你应该知道吧，要打仗了？”
“听说了一点！”
“还敢回来？不错，不像有些怂包软蛋，已经在搞调动了。”高团长紧接着问道：“你对你的工作有没有什么想法？”
“听从组织安排！”
“好，让你当卫生员是不可能了，你小子现在也不是那块料！有两个安排，第一到团里宣传科工作，做具体的宣传工作和战场宣传。第二，回到你们九连担任指导员。”
赵政委解释道：“九连的原连长和指导员，分别担任三营的营长和教导员，原来的职位就空出来了。一排长担任连长，二排长副连，基层部队缺干部。”
“我直接担任正连职干部？”
高团长摆了摆手道：“这你放心，你原本立了二等功，又上了大学。按理说小说发表也能立功提干，给三个三等功都不过分，但不行，团里得考虑到其他人，决定给你一个嘉奖，一个三等功，你别怕干不来。”
“团长，我到九连！”刘济民斩钉截铁地说道。
“行，不过到了九连负责思想政治教育的同时，也得协助全团的政治思想工作，老赵，你跟他聊聊。”
战前思想动员是战争准备的重中之重，要让战士们认识到为什么要打同志加兄弟的越南。让战士们知道，这是一场正义的战争，报仇的战争。
另外，鉴于越南一直宣传自己是第三军事强国，我军已经近二十年没打仗了，缺乏战争经验，加上害怕苏联介入，难免出现了一些负面情绪。

In the courtyard of the regiment headquarters, the lights were brightly lit, people were coming and going in a hurry, and the atmosphere was extremely tense. When he met an acquaintance, before he spoke, a wisp of white mist came out of his mouth.
Inside the headquarters, Commander Gao was discussing with the political commissar and staff officers the issues of recruit training and equipment transfer.
"Report! Regiment leader, political commissar, soldier Liu Jimin of the 9th Company of the 3rd Battalion has been ordered to return to the team!"
Everyone in the headquarters was attracted by Liu Jimin's voice. Captain Gao closed the document and walked to Liu Jimin to look at it for a moment. He smiled and said to the others: "Look, our assassin is back. This guy is really awesome. He beat several people while filming a movie at Yanying Studio."
"Captain, you can't expose my shortcomings as soon as we meet!" Liu Jimin laughed.
Political commissar Zhao Qingshou came over and said happily: "Our Lu Xun is back?"
"Hello, political commissar!"
"Okay, okay, don't be so loud. You've had a hard journey."
Captain Gao shouted out the door: "Go and bring a bowl of noodles, don't starve our Lu Xun into a Zhou Shuren."
"Hahaha, captain, you are quite humorous!"
"You eat first, and I'll talk to you after you're done."
The stove in the regiment canteen was kept hot. When the noodles were served, Liu Jimin's appetite was whetted. He picked up the chopsticks and stirred it three times quickly. Three mouthfuls turned into two mouthfuls, and he destroyed the bowl of noodles in a short time.
"Hey, I have a good appetite. Are you full? If not, have another bowl."
"Eat up, captain."
Captain Gao took out a cigarette from his pocket and put it into his mouth. After taking a puff, he said, "You should know, right? There's going to be a war?"
"I heard a little bit!"
"You still dare to come back? Yes, it's not like some cowards who are already being transferred." Captain Gao then asked: "Do you have any ideas about your work?"
"Follow the organization's arrangements!"
"Okay, it's impossible for you to be a hygienist. You're not that good now! There are two arrangements. The first is to work in the propaganda department of the regiment and do specific propaganda work and battlefield propaganda. The second is to return to your ninth company as an instructor."
Political Commissar Zhao explained: "The original company commander and instructor of the Ninth Company served as the battalion commander and instructor of the third battalion respectively, and the original positions were vacant. The first platoon leader served as the company commander, and the second platoon leader served as deputy company. The grassroots units were short of cadres."
"Should I directly serve as a full-time cadre?"
Captain Gao waved his hand and said, "Don't worry. You originally achieved second-class merit and went to college. Logically speaking, publishing a novel can also lead to merit and promotion. Giving three third-class merit is not too much. But no, the regiment has to consider other people and decide to give you a commendation and a third-class merit. Don't be afraid that you won't be able to do it."
"Captain, I'm going to the Ninth Company!" Liu Jimin said firmly.
"Okay, but when the Ninth Company is responsible for ideological and political education, it also has to assist the entire regiment in political and ideological work. Lao Zhao, you have a chat with him."
Pre-war ideological mobilization is the top priority in war preparations, and the soldiers must understand why they want to fight Vietnam, a country of comrades and brothers. Let the soldiers know that this is a just war, a war of revenge.
In addition, given that Vietnam has always promoted itself as the third military power, our military has not fought a war in nearly two decades, lacks war experience, and is afraid of Soviet intervention, it is inevitable that there will be some negative emotions.
